luck.label: 3PT luck
luck.text: Threes go in and out by chance. We re-scored every three, by both teams, at the league's 3P%. If that flips this number from plus to minus (or back), it is marked: it rests mostly on shooting luck.

sample.label: small sample
sample.text: This number stands out (top or bottom of the table) but rests on far fewer possessions than most rows, often off court. With so few, it may not hold up.

example.il: Example: Zack Bryant, Bnei Herzliya, 25-26: +64.8, but only 146 possessions with him off the court. Adjusted for sample size it is +3.5.
example.euro: Example: Spencer Dinwiddie, FC Bayern Munich, 25-26: +19.5 on only 339 off-court possessions. Adjusted for sample size it is +1.7.
